scope_note_en: Developmental change of one or more characteristics of the educational system variables in a positive direction in terms of some valued criterion. Use more specific descriptor where appropriate.
Official statements of goals to which the system of education is directed.
Conditions, circumstances or requirements governing admittance to educational institutions or programmes.
Regions, localities, etc., in need of special educational action.
Non fee-paying education.
System of education extending opportunities to all.
Organized activities intended to help individuals or groups use non-work time in a manner conducive to physical and mental well-being.
Relates to the problem. Provision for resolving it should be handled by the "literacy" descriptors.
General term for schemes which offer an alternative to traditional institutional education or for movements which reject the notion of formal schooling.
Encouragement of bilingualism through the teaching of regular courses in both the national language and a second language.
Availability of educational provision.
The use of computers for instruction, testing, student/pupil personnel services, school administrative support services, etc. Use more specific descriptor where appropriate.
Taking into consideration of cultural factors in the educational process.
Systematic process of producing new curricula or improving existing ones. Involves setting out aims, content, methods, evaluation procedures.
Changes in objectives, content or methods initiated, as a rule, in experimental situations.
Change planned or in process of implementation to a major part of a national system of education.
Policy of ensuring equality of educational opportunity in order to achieve universal education.
Refers to ethnic groups, covers also negative aspect of segregation.
Global citizenship education aims to empower learners of all ages to assume active roles, both locally and globally, in building more peaceful, tolerant, inclusive and secure societies.
Changes in educational movement, either past or future, which occur in response to social, economic or environmental trends.
Numerical data used as benchmarks in the formulation and monitoring of educational policy.
Intended or expected results of the educational process.
Conversion of policy goals into operational terms, including some indication of alternative paths to reach these goals.
Refers to both permanent or temporary school closures. The latter can be due to crisis situations such as natural disaster, armed conflict or epidemics.
The use of two or more languages in education, which may include the mother tongue.
